name: leaks
description: Notices private and medical data that reaches the model, lists it per project, and can redact or block it

mode.title: Mode
mode.description: notify: record and notify only; redact: replace each value with a placeholder before the model reads it; block: withhold content and refuse prompts that hold such data

notify.title: Notification
notify.description: How a new finding is announced: toast in Claude Code, system notification, both, or off

storeRawValues.title: Keep full values
storeRawValues.description: Keep the full values found in the history instead of masked ones

ignore.title: Ignore list
ignore.description: Comma-separated texts: a finding whose value or source contains one is skipped

retentionDays.title: History kept (days)
retentionDays.description: Days of history kept before older occurrences are deleted
